title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
abstract: arXiv:2611.14505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same

translated_title: Continual-ARC：测量整个职业生涯中的技能习得
translated_abstract: 智能体框架已成为一种有前景的持续学习机制，与测试时参数化学习并行发展。然而，当前的基准测试存在若干局限性：它们通常只关注单一应用领域，每个实例只提供一次，并且假设学习者只有单一类型，因此基于记忆的系统和基于权重的系统很少在同一尺度上进行比较。我们提出了 Continual-ARC，这是一个由三个 ARC-AGI 版本构建的终身任务流，其任务无需领域知识。相同的任务会在休眠间隔后以新实例的形式再次出现，同时新任务也不断到来。在每个实例上，学习者可以付费获取演示、提交答案，或在框架内执行操作；提交错误时允许重试，但重试需付费。每个实例的得分基于所消耗的反馈预算比例。由于学习者可以在实例之间保留任何内容，基于记忆和基于权重的系统在同一标准下进行评分。
tldr: 提出 Continual-ARC 基准，基于三个 ARC-AGI 版本构建终身任务流，使基于记忆和基于权重的持续学习系统能够在同一预算评分标准下公平比较技能习得能力。
en_tdlr: We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong task stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions that requires no domain knowledge and enables memory-based and weight-based continual learning systems to be fairly compared on the same feedback-budget-based scoring scale.
